Aakash S S is an AI & Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist currently based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He holds a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science from Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology. He has demonstrated domain expertise across Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and end-to-end MLOps deployment.

## Detailed Project Portfolio
### Project 1: Telco Customer Churn MLOps Platform (MLOps & Production ML)
- **Problem**: ML models often fail in production due to fragmented data pipelines, inconsistent environments, manual deployments, weak lineage, and undetected drift.
- **Solution**: Engineered an end-to-end, reproducible MLOps system that automates the journey from versioned customer data to monitored production inference and model promotion.
- **Results**: Achieved 0.847 ROC-AUC, improved recall from 48% to 80% through threshold optimization, and established automated CI/CD, experiment tracking, and drift-aware retraining.
- **Stack**: Python, XGBoost, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins CI/CD, DVC.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/telco-churn-mlops

### Project 2: TN Government AI Scheme Assistant (Conversational AI & RAG)
- **Problem**: Government welfare information is fragmented across 37+ scheme documents and PDFs, making it difficult for citizens to quickly find relevant benefits without hallucination.
- **Solution**: Developed a bilingual (English/Tamil) RAG conversational assistant utilizing ChromaDB embeddings and Groq LLaMA 3.3 for authoritative scheme discovery.
- **Results**: 86/86 validation tests passed, 100% pass rate on 50-query benchmark; deployed for real-time scheme discovery.
- **Stack**: FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, ChromaDB, Groq LLaMA 3.3, RAG, Railway.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/TNGov-AI-Assistant

### Project 3: AI-Based Smart Garbage Segregation Bin (Computer Vision & Edge IoT)
- **Problem**: Manual waste segregation is inefficient and inconsistent; disposal points need low-cost autonomous sorting that remains functional even when cameras degrade.
- **Solution**: Built an autonomous segregation system combining camera-based real-time 5-category waste classification with sensor fallback logic.
- **Results**: Real-time 5-category waste classification with sensor-based fallback, enabling continuous autonomous segregation under both vision-enabled and degraded operating conditions.
- **Stack**: Arduino (C++), ESP32-CAM, Flask, TensorFlow.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/smart-waste-segregation-bin

### Project 4: Smart Child Nutrition Deficiency Tracking System (Full-Stack & Predictive Analytics)
- **Problem**: Child nutrition monitoring often depends on fragmented, manually maintained growth records, limiting early intervention for nutritional risks.
- **Solution**: Built an end-to-end healthcare platform for early risk stratification, multi-deficiency detection, and long-term trend forecasting.
- **Results**: 86.4% risk-classification accuracy, 70% high-risk recall, 92.69% mean accuracy across 7 deficiency predictions, and 6-month nutrition trend forecasting.
- **Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aakash1552005/Smart-Child-Nutrition-Deficiency-Tracking-System
